title: Dawkins Construction LLC — Crafted with purpose. Built to belong.
body: Dawkins Construction LLC is an owner-led general contractor and custom carpentry company based in Foster, Rhode Island. Services include custom carpentry, finish work, home additions, kitchen remodeling, bathroom remodeling, decks, barns, renovations, and outdoor structures. Dawkins Construction serves homeowners in Foster and neighboring Rhode Island communities. Call (401) 855-3705 to discuss a project. Clients can use the client portal for progress, selections, photographs, and updates. Trade partners can use the trade partner desk for plans, agreements, schedules, credentials, invoices, and change information.
